newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris broker boosts Axa rating.
newsitem.headline: Paris broker boosts Axa rating.

text.p: French brokerage SGE Delahaye boosted its rating on Wednesday on Axa shares to "outperform" from neutral after the French insurer reported a 52 percent jump in first-half net attributable profit, fund managers said.
The insurance analyst at SGE Delahaye could not be immediately reached for confirmation.
At 1123 GMT, Axa was up 3.71 percent at 296.60 francs in 657,000 shares traded while the blue-chip CAC-40 index was up only 0.67 percent.
Axa's profits beat most analysts' forecasts.
"It was a very good set of numbers," said one analyst who did not want be named. "Even when you look at the underlying performance it was good."
Stripping out exceptional items, he said, earnings per share were up 25 percent.
